Likelihood Intervals for Squared Partial Correlations

Source: R/betaLB-p-cor-lb.R
PCorLB.Rd

Extract already-computed point estimates and intervals from an LB context. For multi-coefficient nonnegative effects, vector projection is conservative.

Usage

PCorLB(object)

Arguments

object

Context returned by LB(), with this family computed.

Value

Object of class betalb; use coef(), confint() or summary().

See also

Other Likelihood Effect Extractors: BetaLB(), DeltaRSqLB(), DiffBetaLB(), FSqLB(), RSqLB(), SCorLB()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

fit <- stats::lm(formula = mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
out <- LB(object = fit, effects = "pcor", type = "mvn", alpha = 0.05)
PCorLB(object = out)
#> Call:
#> LB(object = fit, type = "mvn", alpha = 0.05, effects = "pcor")
#> 
#> Likelihood intervals (vector projections are conservative)
#> type = "mvn"
#>   effect type alpha estimate  lower  upper lower_status upper_status
#> 1     wt  mvn  0.05   0.5643 0.3082 0.7537           ok           ok
#> 2     hp  mvn  0.05   0.2992 0.0666 0.5566           ok           ok
#>      calibration dimension
#> 1 scalar_profile         1
#> 2 scalar_profile         1
